meta.name: Startup Wars
meta.refresh_cadence: quarterly — product-only benchmark, low expected rate of change; not worth a tighter cadence given thin public footprint

snapshot.one_liner: Browser-based, gamified startup simulation platform where students launch virtual businesses across industries, guided by an AI coach ('Milton'); course-embedded in high school CTE/business courses.
snapshot.why_they_compete: Closest match to Altitut's game-plus-course-embedded model with a student audience and an AI coach, per COMPETITORS.md (#2 of 10).

positioning.value_prop: "Learn. Apply. Win." — practice real founder decisions (pivoting, resource allocation, forecasting) 'without the risk,' with real-time feedback and instructor learning analytics.
positioning.differentiation: A named, persistent AI coach ('Milton') as product mascot/interface, plus institutional learning-analytics for instructors.

1_identity.audience_icp: High school (CTE/business courses) and community college students; also university business programs, corporate training, homeschoolers.

similarity_to_us.rationale: Directly comparable game-plus-course-embedded model and AI-coach interface; primary gap is Altitut's broader web-app/LMS layer beyond the simulation itself. Directional judgment, not a scoring model.

highlight_features.feature: Virtual business simulation across industries (t-shirt brands, food trucks, tech startups)
highlight_features.why_pushed: Core product surface; the simulation itself is the product.
Positioned as a differentiator and a persistent brand mascot.

most_attractive_features.why_it_lands: Personified guidance reduces intimidation for first-time student founders, similar to Fe/male Switch's AI co-founder pattern.
Directly solves the classroom-adoption problem (instructor visibility into student progress).

messaging_conversion.headline_copy: not available — not captured in this desk-research pass
messaging_conversion.pricing: Verbatim license tiers: Basic Access Pass $24.99 (1 simulation, 3 assignments, 12-month access); Startup Access Pass $29.99 (2 simulations, 6 assignments, Milton AI Classroom Guide — marked 'Most Requested'); Premium Access Pass $59.99 (full catalog, 15+ assignments, Milton AI).
messaging_conversion.funnel_path: Per-license purchase by instructor/institution — not a self-serve consumer funnel.
messaging_conversion.social_proof: Claims 10,000+ students across 100+ institutions and a 97%+ instructor satisfaction rate (on-site claim, not independently verified).

insights_to_imbibe: The tiered, transparent per-license pricing tied directly to catalog breadth/assignment count is a clean, easy-to-copy monetization ladder for an instructor/institution buyer.
A named AI coach as a persistent product mascot/interface is a strong branding device — directly comparable to what Altitut could do with its own AI mentor.

8_synthesis.winning_formula: Transparent, tiered per-license B2B pricing plus a personified AI coach, sold directly into classroom/CTE adoption rather than a consumer funnel.
8_synthesis.recent_strategic_shifts: not available — insufficient historical data this pass.

steal: Tiered per-license pricing tied to catalog breadth, transparent and easy to compare.
A named, persistent AI coach as the product's face.
test: Whether a named AI-mentor mascot (mirroring Milton) measurably improves conversion/engagement for Altitut's own AI guide 'Alti.'

content_pack_hooks.pillar_or_format: Named AI coach as persistent brand interface
content_pack_hooks.why_feed_forward: Directly transferable to Altitut's 'Alti' mentor — proven pattern across two competitors in this set (F/MS's Elona/PlayPal, Startup Wars' Milton).
